meta.name: churn-prevention
meta.description: When the user wants to reduce churn, build cancellation flows, set up save offers, recover failed payments, or implement retention strategies. Also use when the user mentions 'churn,' 'cancel flow,' 'offboarding,' 'save offer,' 'dunning,' 'failed payment recovery,' 'win-back,' 'retention,' 'exit survey,' 'pause subscription,' 'involuntary churn,' 'people keep canceling,' 'churn rate is too high,' 'how do I keep users,' or 'customers are leaving.' Use this whenever someone is losing subscribers or wants to build systems to prevent it. For post-cancel win-back email sequences, see emails. For in-app upgrade paywalls, see paywalls.

copy.tagline: 减少用户流失，构建挽留策略与取消流程
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果用户不断取消订阅，你想建立系统化的挽留机制。
copy.tagline_en: Reduce churn by building cancellation flows and retention strategies
copy.fit_line_en: For you if users keep canceling and you want to build systematic retention.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会帮你设计取消流程、设置挽留优惠、恢复失败支付，并制定留存策略。它会先收集你的业务数据，然后给出具体方案。
howto.when: 当你提到“流失”、“取消流程”、“挽留优惠”、“支付失败恢复”等关键词，或想减少用户流失时触发。

say.text: 我的月流失率是8%，怎么降低？
say.note: Claude 会询问你的业务细节，然后给出定制方案。

say.text: 帮我设计一个取消订阅的挽留流程。
say.note: Claude 会引导你完成从调查到优惠的完整流程设计。

say.text: 支付失败的用户怎么自动恢复？
say.note: Claude 会提供智能重试和催缴邮件序列方案。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude helps you design cancellation flows, set up save offers, recover failed payments, and implement retention strategies. It first gathers your business data, then provides specific solutions.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention 'churn', 'cancel flow', 'save offer', 'failed payment recovery', or similar keywords, or when you want to reduce subscriber loss.

say_en.text: My monthly churn rate is 8%. How can I reduce it?
say_en.note: Claude will ask for details and provide a tailored plan.

say_en.text: Design a save flow for when users cancel their subscription.
say_en.note: Claude will guide you through the full flow design from survey to offer.

say_en.text: How can I automatically recover failed payments?
say_en.note: Claude will provide smart retry and dunning email sequence solutions.
